steps.caption: Home
steps.narration: This is Home in the ConstructHUB CRM. It shows where your business stands today.

steps.caption: Open estimates
steps.narration: Open estimates counts the bids you've sent that are still waiting on an answer.

steps.caption: Jobs won
steps.narration: Jobs won counts your approved estimates, with their total underneath.

steps.caption: Unscheduled jobs
steps.narration: Unscheduled jobs are the ones sitting in the Approved stage of your pipeline.

steps.caption: Open invoices
steps.narration: Open invoices shows the invoices you've sent, and what is still owed on them.

steps.caption: Click a number
steps.narration: Click any number to jump to that list. This one opens your open invoices.

steps.caption: Clients
steps.narration: The next row starts with how many clients are in your book.

steps.caption: Pipeline value
steps.narration: Pipeline value adds up every open project. Cancelled and paid jobs are left out.

steps.caption: Leads to follow up
steps.narration: Leads to follow up counts the leads still sitting in the first stage.

steps.caption: Needs attention: new leads
steps.narration: Needs attention is your to-do list. New leads are at the top.

steps.caption: Needs an estimate
steps.narration: Needs an estimate lists the leads you haven't sent a bid to yet. Click one to open it.

steps.caption: Activity
steps.narration: Activity shows what your team and your clients have been doing.

steps.caption: Recent projects
steps.narration: Choose Recent projects to see your newest jobs, each with its stage.

steps.caption: Menu: Home
steps.narration: You'll find Home at the top of the menu on the left.

youtube.title: How to read the Home dashboard | ConstructHUB CRM
youtube.description: A short walkthrough of Home in the ConstructHUB CRM. You will see what the four counters mean, how to jump from a number to its list, and how Needs attention and Activity show you what to work on today.
